exam_scheme.note: Selection for Police Sub-Inspector comprises: Stage 1 Endurance Test (ET) & Physical Standard Test (PST) (qualifying), Stage 2 Written Examination (Paper 1 Descriptive 50 marks + Paper 2 Objective 150 marks = 200 marks total), followed by Stage 3 Document Verification and Medical Examination. Negative marking in Paper 2 is 0.375 marks (25% of 1.5 marks) per wrong answer.

stages.source_label: KSP PSI Endurance and Physical Standard Test Regulations

papers.paper_name: Male Candidates: 1,600m Run (max 7 mins), Long Jump (min 3.80m) or High Jump (min 1.20m), Shot Put 7.26 kg (min 5.60m) & Physical Measurements
papers.qualifying_threshold: Qualifying standards (Height: min 168 cm, Chest: 86 cm with 5 cm expansion)

papers.paper_name: Female & In-Service Candidates: 400m Run (max 2 mins), Long Jump (min 2.75m) or High Jump (min 0.90m), Shot Put 4 kg (min 3.75m) & Physical Measurements

stages.source_label: KSP PSI Written Examination Blueprint and Syllabus

papers.paper_name: Paper 1 — Descriptive Test (Essay Writing 20m, English-Kannada Translation 20m, Précis Writing 10m)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Evaluated for merit along with Paper 2

papers.paper_name: Paper 2 — Objective MCQ (100 Questions on General Studies, Constitution, Current Affairs, Science, History, Geography & Mental Ability)
papers.negative_marking: 0.375 marks deducted per wrong answer (25% penalty of 1.5 marks)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Composite evaluation of Paper 1 (50m) + Paper 2 (150m) = 200 marks determines merit

stages.source_label: KSP Medical Board Standards & Document Verification Directives

papers.paper_name: Scrutiny of Bachelor's Degree Certificate, Kannada Medium Certificate, Rural Certificate, Category Proof & Medical Fitness Check
papers.qualifying_threshold: Document verification and medical fitness qualifying

financial_package.note: Police Sub-Inspectors in Karnataka State Police are placed in the state revised pay scale of ₹37,900–₹70,850 with entry basic pay of ₹37,900.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Karnataka State Police Revised Pay Rules Schedule
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on entry basic pay of ₹37,900 at 58% DA (₹21,982 effective 01.07.2025), HRA (9% to 27%: ₹3,411 to ₹10,233 for district postings and Bengaluru City Police Commissionerate), Uniform Maintenance Allowance, Investigation Allowance, Risk Allowance, net of NPS deduction (10% of Basic+DA = ₹5,988) and Professional Tax.
official_perks: Dearness Allowance (DA) revised semi-annually per Karnataka Finance Department orders
House Rent Allowance (HRA) categorized across Bengaluru (Class X) and other districts
Officer uniform allowance, holster kit upkeep, and annual accoutrements grant
Investigation allowance, police mobile conveyance allowance, and CUG SIM entitlement
Cashless medical facility under Jyothi Sanjeevini Scheme for officer and family
Contributory pension coverage under National Pension System (NPS)
